name: Machine Oracle
responsibility: Chief, reasoning, planning, decisions and system control.
requirement: Chief status, reasoning requests, plans, pending approvals, decision history, safety review and provider status.

name: Memory Vault
requirement: Global archival access, canonical records, superseded decisions, version history, restore and provenance. Not a second arbitrary file browser.

name: Astral Greenhouse / Gardens
responsibility: Visual discovery, browsing, inspiration, evolving work and asset selection.
requirement: Cross-World visual discovery, work-in-progress review, inspiration boards, asset candidates and links into each World's own immersive gallery.
mustNotBecome: The only gallery; each World still has its own gallery.

name: Throne Reactor
responsibility: System engine, configuration, automation and power controls.
requirement: Settings, providers, automations, permissions, feature flags, system state, integration health and controlled maintenance.

name: Void Railway
responsibility: Navigation and transport between Project Worlds.
requirement: World directory, recent Worlds, route transitions, resume state, deep links and World creation proposals subject to approval.

name: Observatory
responsibility: Overviews, analytics, long-range planning and project status.
requirement: Atlas-wide project inventory, progress, activity, deadlines, risks, blockers, stale projects and strategic review.

name: Cosmic Aquarium
responsibility: Video, sound and media that does not have a correct dedicated space.
requirement: Media index, preview metadata, unplaced media queue and reassignment into a correct World when one is identified.

name: Leviathan Spine
responsibility: Structural backbone, infrastructure and foundational systems.
requirement: Storage providers, file references, repository links, schemas, indexing, relationship graph, backups, validation and diagnostics.

name: Eclipse Monastery
requirement: Personal systems, reflection, routines, development plans and the experiential interface to relevant Chief outputs.
mustNotBecome: Chief itself or a medical decision-maker.
